notes: Every issue of 1970-1972 read through a mention pass: every number followed by a street name in the EAS street list, then a filter dropping other cities, home addresses, advertisements and addresses recurring in six or more issues (advertisers and the masthead); the 360 surviving windows were read by hand. Taken: dated events at buildings, retrospective building histories, and dated occupancy by institutions, associations, churches, clinics, theatres, schools and firms. Not taken: display and classified advertising, home addresses of private people, crime reports at homes, and out-of-city pages.

coverage.remaining: 1973-1989 (839 issues) not yet read. Advertisements in these issues were not extracted.
coverage.note: 2294 numbered-address mentions in 150 issues; 360 survived the filter and were read; 40 findings.
